# AutoTelegramForward

> AutoTelegramForward v2.0.0 is a self-hosted Telegram message routing platform: one task fans out from M source chats to N target chats with per-task content rules, optional AI rewriting, durable ordered delivery and a fail-closed multi-tenant control plane. It ships as four microservices (bot, core, logger, web) plus a REST API, CLI, dashboard and Flutter client.

Key facts, all derived from the repository at build time:

- Version: 2.0.0 (v2.0.0, 2026-10-16)
- Source: https://github.com/Opselon/AutoTelegramForward
- License: MIT
- Services: 4 (core, logger, api/web gateway, bot UI)
- UI languages: 10 (en, fa, ru, zh, pt, uz, id, es, fr, it) with enforced 1:1 catalog parity and strict English fallback
- Localized strings: 1168
- CLI command groups: 24
- gRPC RPCs: 61
- Registered REST routes parsed from api/main.go: 81
- Media classes handled: 12

## Feature deep dives

- [Multi-source → multi-target routing](https://opselon.github.io/AutoTelegramForward/features/multi-source-routing/): A single task can watch any number of source chats and deliver to any number of targets, with the primary pair mirrored and forum topics addressable per target.
- [Per-task content rules](https://opselon.github.io/AutoTelegramForward/features/per-task-content-rules/): Blacklists, whitelists, link handling, regex gates, length limits and ordered replacements — evaluated cheapest-first, with per-source and per-target overrides.
- [AI rewriting](https://opselon.github.io/AutoTelegramForward/features/ai-rewriting/): Enable or disable LLM rewriting per task, pick a provider, write your own prompts with version history, and keep forwarding even when the model is unreachable.
- [Observability & log history](https://opselon.github.io/AutoTelegramForward/features/observability-and-logs/): Every delivery is attributable: the central logger stores queryable history with service, owner and correlation id, and dead letters can be replayed.
- [Ordered delivery](https://opselon.github.io/AutoTelegramForward/features/ordered-delivery/): Lease-based durable workers, per-channel delivery lanes that preserve post order, atomic cursor persistence, retry with jitter, and no duplicate sends.
- [Dedup, replies & edits](https://opselon.github.io/AutoTelegramForward/features/deduplication-and-replies/): SHA-256 content and album fingerprinting kills duplicate forwards, reply chains stay linked, and edits and deletions propagate within a bounded window.
- [Clients & interfaces](https://opselon.github.io/AutoTelegramForward/features/clients-and-interfaces/): Telegram bot UI, React dashboard behind a Rust Axum gateway, Flutter client and a REST/gRPC control plane — all enforced against the same contract fixtures.
- [Multilingual UI](https://opselon.github.io/AutoTelegramForward/features/multilingual-ui/): English, Persian, Russian, Chinese, Portuguese, Uzbek, Indonesian, Spanish, French and Italian share one catalog with enforced 1:1 parity.
- [DevOps CLI & upgrades](https://opselon.github.io/AutoTelegramForward/features/devops-cli/): 24 command groups cover setup, tasks, logs, backups, docker, k8s and TLS, with a read-only validator for CI and an upgrade engine behind a health gate.

- [Multi-source → multi-target routing](https://opselon.github.io/AutoTelegramForward/features/multi-source-routing/): One task, many sources, many targets.
- [Per-task content rules](https://opselon.github.io/AutoTelegramForward/features/per-task-content-rules/): Blacklists, whitelists, links, regex and replacements.
- [AI rewriting](https://opselon.github.io/AutoTelegramForward/features/ai-rewriting/): Optional LLM pass with custom prompt templates.
- [Observability & log history](https://opselon.github.io/AutoTelegramForward/features/observability-and-logs/): Attributable logs, stats, DLQ replay.
- [Ordered delivery](https://opselon.github.io/AutoTelegramForward/features/ordered-delivery/): Bursts delivered in posted order.
- [Dedup, replies & edits](https://opselon.github.io/AutoTelegramForward/features/deduplication-and-replies/): No repeats, no orphaned replies.
- [Clients & interfaces](https://opselon.github.io/AutoTelegramForward/features/clients-and-interfaces/): Bot, dashboard, mobile and API parity.

- [Scheduling & delays](https://opselon.github.io/AutoTelegramForward/features/scheduling-and-delays/): Delays, windows and the edit guard.
